config.code_loss: mean teacher-forced code CE over three levels
config.early_targets: frozen oracle-prefix decoder distributions, KL averaged over digits
config.final_target: true four digits, mean cross entropy
config.rollout: hard argmax forward, softmax straight-through backward, generated earlier embeddings
config.initialization: identical fresh predictor and event positions in both arms
config.budget: equal epochs and optimizer updates; both arms execute the auxiliary forward path
config.selection: fixed final epoch, no test selection
